description: Pathfinder 2e Player Core (Remaster) — full common Player Core breadth for the Fighter wizard, the Wizard class representative subset, and the level-up slice (levels 2–3): class advancement tables (Fighter's Bravery), the wizard's spells-per-day table, level-2 class feats for both classes, level-2 skill feats, level-3 general feats, and a rank-2 arcane spell subset. Records verified against Archives of Nethys and the pinned Foundry pf2e-8.4.1 snapshot (see rules-data/attestation.json).
